question: Ramagya sold his computer at three successive discounts of 18%, 12%, and 5%. If the marked price of the computer is Rs. 36000, then find the net selling price of the computer. (Correct to two places of decimals.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

18% = 9/50, 12% = 3/25, 5% = 1/20

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2bac36b495490422eba8bf9084e861bf820d9b6cc08fa6644588575628bcbec.png] 

According to the question,

12500 = 36000

⇒ 1 = 360/125

⇒ 8569 = 360/125 × 8569 = 24678.72 Rs.

**Hence, Rs. 24678.72 is the correct answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__ **

Given:

Three successive discounts of 18%, 12%, and 5% and market price = Rs. 36.000

Formula Used:

Single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of a % and b %

= (a + b - (ab)/(100))%

Calculation:

Here, a = 18% , and b = 12 %

So, the single discount gets, (18 + 12 - 18 × 12/100) %

 

⇒ (30 - 2.16) %

⇒ 27.84 %

Again,

Here, a = 27.84 % , and b = 5 %

So, the single discount gets,

(27.84 + 5 - 27.84 × 5/100) %

 

⇒ (32.84 - 1.392) %

⇒ 31.448 % 

After the discount, the selling price will be ,

⇒ 36000 × 68.552 / 100

⇒ 360 × 68.5552 

= Rs. 24678.72
